import json,sys,datetime,collections
P="journal.json"
def load(path=P):
    try: return json.load(open(path))
    except Exception: return []
def log(entry,path=P):
    d=load(path); d.append({"t":str(datetime.datetime.now()),"text":entry,"mood":score(entry)}); json.dump(d,open(path,"w")); return len(d)
POS={"happy","good","great","excited","calm","proud"};NEG={"sad","bad","tired","anxious","stressed","angry"}
def score(t):
    w=t.lower().split(); return sum(x in POS for x in w)-sum(x in NEG for x in w)
def reflect(path=P):
    d=load(path)
    if not d: return "No entries yet."
    avg=sum(e["mood"] for e in d)/len(d); words=collections.Counter(w for e in d for w in e["text"].lower().split() if len(w)>4)
    return f"{len(d)} entries, avg mood {avg:.2f}, themes: {[w for w,_ in words.most_common(3)]}"
if __name__=="__main__":
    print(reflect() if sys.argv[1:]==["reflect"] else log(" ".join(sys.argv[1:])))
